newsitem.title: UK: CWC in deal to boost bandwith capacity.
newsitem.headline: CWC in deal to boost bandwith capacity.

text.p: CIENA Corporation has won a contract to supply the UK's Cable & Wireless Communications Plc with technology to boost the capacity of part of its fibre optic network, CIENA said on Tuesday.
The Nasdaq-listed company said deployment of its MultiWave Sentry technology will allow CWC to multiply the capacity of its fibre optic network by 16 times, reducing the expense of laying new cable.

Cable telephone and television group CWC was formed earlier this year from a merger of the Mercury arm of Cable & Wireless Plc plus the UK cable operations of Bell Cablemedia, NYNEX Corp and Videotron.

"CIENA's proven experience of alleviating strained bandwidth in similar networks in the U.S. and Japan will allow CWC to deliver services quickly and without the need for expensive capital investment," said Roger Bates, managing director of CIENA UK.
CIENA said it had also signed an agreement with communications infrastructure supplier BICC Group Plc to provide installation and support services in connection with the CWC deployment.
CIENA and BICC may work together to deploy CIENA systems in additional international markets as the need arises.
